admin.help.detail.activity.message: 📊 /activity - Activity system toggle Description: Enable or disable the group's activity system. Usage: • Send in the group: /activity • Select the button to enable or disable it Activity rules: • Sending a text message adds +1 • Non-text messages do not reduce activity, but require a minimum activity level • Non-text messages sent with insufficient activity are deleted, and the user is notified privately • Highly active users can skip spam detection when a threshold is configured Benefits: • Prevent new users from immediately posting advertising images or stickers • Encourage normal text conversations • Reduce false positives for highly active users Permission: Group administrator
admin.help.detail.activityskip.message: 📈 /activityskip - Activity-based skip threshold Description: Set the activity level at which spam detection is skipped. Usage: • View configuration: /activityskip • Set threshold: /activityskip <value> Examples: • /activityskip 10 - Skip detection when activity >= 10 • /activityskip 0 - Disable this feature Configuration priority: • Global configuration > 0 → Use the global configuration • Global configuration = 0 → Use the group configuration • Global configuration < 0 → Disable globally Permission: Group administrator
admin.help.detail.antichannel.message: 🎭 /antichannel - Channel identity protection settings Description: Prevent users from posting in the group as a channel. Usage: • Send in the group: /antichannel • Select the button to enable or disable it How it works: • Detect the message sender's identity • Delete the message if it was sent as a channel • Record the number of warnings Use cases: • Reduce channel advertisements • Prevent channel promotion • Maintain a healthy group environment Permission: Group administrator
admin.help.detail.antispam.message: 🛡️ /antispam - Anti-spam settings Description: Enable or disable anti-spam protection for the group. Usage: • Send in the group: /antispam • Select the button to enable or disable it Detection methods: • Rule engine - Keyword, URL, and frequency detection • ML classifier - TF-IDF + SVM • Semantic analysis - Embedding similarity Training: • Use /spam to mark spam messages • Use /notspam to correct false positives Permission: Group administrator
admin.help.detail.approve.message: ✅ /approve - Approve a report Description: Approve a spam report, ban the user, and delete the message. Usage: • /approve <report_id> Examples: • /approve 123 • /approve 456 Result: • Ban the reported user • Delete the reported message • Add it to the spam sample training dataset • Mark the report as approved Tips: • Use /reports to view pending reports • The report ID is shown in the report list Permission: Group administrator
admin.help.detail.ban.message: 🚫 /ban - Ban a member Description: Permanently ban a user and prevent them from joining the group. Usage: • Reply to a user's message: /ban [reason] • Specify a user ID: /ban <user_id> [reason] • Select a user: /ban @user [reason] (type @ to select from the list) • Delete all messages: /ban -d [reason] Examples: • /ban Repeated violations • /ban 123456789 Malicious advertising • /ban -d Spam advertisements - Ban the user and delete all of their messages -d parameter: • Add -d to delete all historical messages from the user • Useful for thoroughly cleaning up users posting spam advertisements Difference from kick: • ban - Permanently banned and unable to rejoin • kick - Can rejoin after being kicked Unban: • Use the /unban command Permission: Group administrator
admin.help.detail.cleanup.message: 🧹 /cleanup - Clean up flagged users Description: Clean up users in the group based on official Telegram flags. Usage: • /cleanup - Preview the cleanup and show the number of flagged users • /cleanup run - Clean up all flagged users • /cleanup restricted - Clean up restricted users only • /cleanup scam - Clean up users marked as scams only • /cleanup fake - Clean up users marked as fake only • /cleanup deleted - Clean up deleted users only • /cleanup refresh - Force-refresh the member cache • /cleanup cache - View cache status Flagged user types: • 🚫 restricted - Spam or violating accounts restricted by Telegram • ⚠️ scam - Accounts marked as scams • 🤖 fake - Accounts marked as fake identities • ❌ deleted - Deleted accounts Cache behavior: • The member list is cached for 1 hour to reduce API calls • Use /cleanup refresh to force-refresh the cache • Use /cleanup cache to view cache status Notes: • Requires Telethon client support • Administrators are not cleaned up • Cleanup actions cannot be undone • Kicked users can rejoin Permission: Group administrator
admin.help.detail.clearwarnings.message: 🗑️ /clearwarnings - Clear warnings Description: Clear all warning records for a user. Usage: • Reply to a user's message: /clearwarnings • Specify a user ID: /clearwarnings <user_id> • Select a user: /clearwarnings @user (type @ to select from the list) Examples: • /clearwarnings • /clearwarnings 123456789 Notes: • Cleared warnings cannot be restored • The user's warning count starts over Permission: Group administrator
admin.help.detail.curfew.message: 🌙 /curfew - Curfew mode settings Description: Set curfew hours and restrict message sending based on user activity. Usage: • View status: /curfew • Enable curfew: /curfew <start_time> <end_time> [timezone] • Disable curfew: /curfew off Examples: • /curfew 23:00 7:00 - Enable curfew (default +8 time zone) • /curfew 23 7 +9 - Enable curfew (specified +9 time zone) • /curfew off - Disable curfew Restrictions: • Activity = 0: Cannot send any messages • Activity < 10: Cannot send non-text messages • Activity >= 10: Can send messages normally Time format: • HH:MM or HH (minutes are optional) • Overnight periods are supported (such as 23:00-07:00) • Time zone range: -12 to +14 Permission: Group administrator
admin.help.detail.delafter.message: 🗑️ /delafter - Delete later messages Description: Delete N messages after the specified message, including the replied-to message itself. Usage: • Reply to a message: /delafter <count> Examples: • /delafter 10 - Delete 10 later messages, including the replied-to message • /delafter 50 - Delete 50 later messages, including the replied-to message Limits: • Up to 1000 messages can be deleted at once • You must reply to a message • The Bot can only delete messages it has permission to delete Permission: Group administrator
admin.help.detail.delbefore.message: 🗑️ /delbefore - Delete earlier messages Description: Delete N messages before the specified message, including the replied-to message itself. Usage: • Reply to a message: /delbefore <count> Examples: • /delbefore 10 - Delete 10 earlier messages, including the replied-to message • /delbefore 50 - Delete 50 earlier messages, including the replied-to message Limits: • Up to 1000 messages can be deleted at once • You must reply to a message • The Bot can only delete messages it has permission to delete Permission: Group administrator
admin.help.detail.delrange.message: 🗑️ /delrange - Delete a message range Description: Delete all messages between a starting message and an ending message. Usage: 1. Reply to the message that will serve as the starting message 2. Send the command: /delrange <end_message_id_or_link> Examples: • Reply to a message, then send: /delrange 12345 • Reply to a message, then send: /delrange https://t.me/c/xxx/12345 Tips: • On desktop, right-click a message and select Copy Message Link • Supports a numeric ID or a complete message link • The start and end can be given in either order and are detected automatically Limits: • You must reply to the starting message • Up to 1000 messages can be deleted at once • The Bot can only delete messages it has permission to delete Permission: Group administrator
admin.help.detail.groupset.message: ⚙️ /groupset - Group settings (centralized menu) Description: Open the main group configuration menu to manage all group settings in one place. Usage: • Send in the group: /groupset • Select the feature you want to configure Available settings: • Verification method (12 options, including math, slider, and Q&A) • Verification timeout • Anti-spam toggle • Channel identity protection toggle • Activity system toggle • Activity-based skip threshold Permission: Group administrator
admin.help.detail.help.message: ❓ /help - Help command Description: View the command list or detailed usage for a specific command. Usage: • /help - Display the command list • /help <command> - View detailed command documentation Examples: • /help • /help groupset • /help kick • /help warn Tips: • Type / to automatically display available commands • Group administrators and regular members see different commands Permission: All users
admin.help.detail.kick.message: 👢 /kick - Kick a member Description: Kick a user from the group while allowing them to rejoin. Usage: • Reply to a user's message: /kick [reason] • Specify a user ID: /kick <user_id> [reason] • Select a user: /kick @user [reason] (type @ to select from the list) • Delete all messages: /kick -d [reason] Examples: • /kick Violating group rules • /kick 123456789 Posting advertisements • /kick -d Spam advertisements - Kick the user and delete all of their messages -d parameter: • Add -d to delete all historical messages from the user • Useful for quickly cleaning up users posting spam advertisements Difference from ban: • kick - The user can rejoin • ban - The user is permanently banned Permission: Group administrator
admin.help.detail.mute.message: 🔇 /mute - Mute a member Description: Prevent a user from sending messages in the group. Usage: • Reply to a user's message: /mute [duration] [reason] • Specify a user ID: /mute <user_id> [duration] [reason] • Select a user: /mute @user [duration] [reason] (type @ to select from the list) Duration format: • Minutes: 5m, 10m, 30m • Hours: 1h, 2h, 24h • Days: 1d, 7d, 30d • Permanent: forever or omit the duration Examples: • /mute 10m Flooding the chat • /mute 1d Insulting others • /mute forever Serious violation Permission: Group administrator
admin.help.detail.nospam.message: ✅ /nospam - Mark a message as not spam Description: /nospam is an alias of /notspam; both provide exactly the same functionality. Detailed usage: Use /help notspam to view the complete command documentation. Quick usage: • Reply to a normal message and send /nospam [note] • Mark a falsely detected message as normal for model training Permission: Group administrator
admin.help.detail.notspam.message: ✅ /notspam, /nospam, /unspam - Mark a message as not spam Description: Mark a falsely detected spam message as normal for training the anti-spam model. (/nospam and /unspam are aliases of /notspam; all three provide exactly the same functionality.) Usage: • Reply to a message: /notspam [note] - Preventive training • Specify a message ID: /notspam <message_id_or_link> [note] - Correct a false positive Supported formats: • Numeric ID: 12345 • Private group link: https://t.me/c/1234567890/12345 • Public group link: https://t.me/channel_name/12345 Examples: • /notspam (reply to a normal message) • /notspam This is a normal discussion (reply to a normal message and add a note) • /notspam 12345 (mark deleted message 12345 as a false positive) • /notspam https://t.me/c/1234567890/12345 (use a message link) Training: • Marked messages are used to train the ML model • Adds negative samples and reduces the false-positive rate Limits: • Available only to administrators • The message cache remains valid for 1 hour Permission: Group administrator
admin.help.detail.reject.message: ❌ /reject - Reject a report Description: Reject a spam report and mark it as a false report or as requiring no action. Usage: • /reject <report_id> Examples: • /reject 123 • /reject 456 Result: • Do not ban the user • Do not delete the message • Mark the report as rejected Use cases: • The reported content is not spam • The report is false or malicious • The normal message requires no action Tips: • Use /reports to view pending reports • The report ID is shown in the report list Permission: Group administrator
admin.help.detail.report.message: 🚨 /report - Report spam Description: /report is an alias of /spam; both provide exactly the same functionality. Detailed usage: Use /help spam to view the complete command documentation. Quick usage: • Reply to a spam message and send /report [reason] • Regular member: Submit a report to the administrators • Administrator: Ban the user and delete the message immediately Permission: All members
admin.help.detail.reports.message: 📋 /reports - View reports Description: View the group's pending reports. Usage: • Send in the group: /reports Displayed information: • Report ID • Reported message content • Reporter • Report time • Action buttons Next actions: • Select a button for quick processing • Or use /approve to accept the report • Or use /reject to reject the report Permission: Group administrator
admin.help.detail.settimeout.message: ⏱️ /settimeout - Set verification timeout Description: Set the timeout for new users to complete verification. Usage: • Send in the group: /settimeout <seconds> • Send only /settimeout to view the current configuration Examples: • /settimeout 120 - Set to 2 minutes • /settimeout 300 - Set to 5 minutes Parameter range: • Minimum: 30 seconds • Maximum: 300 seconds (5 minutes) • Default: 120 seconds (2 minutes) Permission: Group administrator
admin.help.detail.setverify.message: 🔐 /setverify - Set verification method Description: Set the verification method for new users joining the group. Usage: • Send in the group: /setverify • Select a verification method (13 options available) Verification methods: • 🔢 Math verification - Simple arithmetic problem • 🎯 Slider verification - Slide to verify • ❓ Q&A verification - Custom question • 😊 Emoji verification - Select an emoji • 🖼️ Image CAPTCHA - Image recognition • 🍯 Honeypot verification - Hidden field • 🧩 Puzzle verification - Jigsaw puzzle • 🔐 Turnstile - Cloudflare • 🤝 Friendly - Friendly verification • 🖼️ hCaptcha - Image verification • 🔒 MTCaptcha - Adaptive verification • ⚡ ALTCHA - Proof of work • 🎲 Random verification - Random selection Permission: Group administrator
admin.help.detail.spam.message: 🚨 /spam or /report - Report spam Description: Report a message as spam for training the anti-spam model. (/report and /spam provide exactly the same functionality; use whichever is easier to remember.) Usage: • Regular member: /spam [reason] - Submit a report • Administrator: /spam [reason] - Ban the user and delete the replied-to message • Administrator: /spam -d [reason] - Ban the user and delete all of their messages Examples: • /spam Posting advertisements • /spam -d Sending large amounts of spam Reporting process for regular members: 1. Reply to the spam message and send /spam 2. Administrators receive a report notification 3. An administrator reviews it with /reports 4. Accept it with /approve <report_id> Limits: • Regular members can submit up to 10 reports per day • You must reply to the message being reported Training: • Marked messages are used to train the ML model • Improves spam detection accuracy Permission: All members
admin.help.detail.unban.message: ✅ /unban - Unban a user Description: Remove a user's ban status. Usage: • Reply to a user's message: /unban • Specify a user ID: /unban <user_id> • Select a user: /unban @user (type @ to select from the list) Examples: • /unban • /unban 123456789 Notes: • The user can rejoin the group after being unbanned • They need a new invitation link or must be added by an administrator Permission: Group administrator
admin.help.detail.unmute.message: 🔊 /unmute - Lift a mute/ban Description: Remove a user's mute or ban status. Usage: • Reply to a user's message: /unmute • Specify a user ID: /unmute <user_id> • Select a user: /unmute @user (type @ to select from the list) Examples: • /unmute • /unmute 123456789 Notes: • Can remove mutes and bans applied by the Bot • /unmute and /unban provide exactly the same functionality • Cannot remove restrictions applied natively by Telegram Permission: Group administrator
admin.help.detail.unspam.message: ✅ /unspam - Mark a message as not spam Description: /unspam is an alias of /notspam; both provide exactly the same functionality. Detailed usage: Use /help notspam to view the complete command documentation. Quick usage: • Reply to a normal message and send /unspam [note] • Mark a falsely detected message as normal for model training Permission: Group administrator
admin.help.detail.verifyconfig.message: 📋 /verifyconfig - View verification configuration Description: View the current group's verification configuration. Usage: • Send in the group: /verifyconfig Displayed information: • Current verification method • Verification timeout • Configuration source (group/global) Permission: Group administrator
admin.help.detail.warn.message: ⚠️ /warn - Warn a member Description: Issue a warning to a user and automatically ban them when the limit is reached. Usage: • Reply to a user's message: /warn [reason] • Specify a user ID: /warn <user_id> [reason] • Select a user: /warn @user [reason] (type @ to select from the list) Examples: • /warn Posting irrelevant content • /warn 123456789 Violating group rules Warning system: • Default limit: 3 warnings • At the limit: Automatic ban • View records: /warnings • Clear warnings: /clearwarnings Permission: Group administrator
admin.help.detail.warnings.message: 📋 /warnings - View warning records Description: View a user's warning history. Usage: • Without specifying a user: /warnings - View your own warnings • Reply to a user's message: /warnings - View that user's warnings • Specify a user ID: /warnings <user_id> • Select a user: /warnings @user (type @ to select from the list) Examples: • /warnings - View your own warnings • /warnings 123456789 - View the specified user's warnings Displayed information: • Number of active warnings (within 30 days) • Warning reasons and times • Escalating penalty information • Expired warning markers Permission: • View your own warnings - All members • View another user's warnings - Group administrator
admin.help.detail.whitelist.message: 📋 /whitelist - Whitelist management Description: Manage the Bot's group whitelist. Only whitelisted groups can use the Bot. Usage: • List the whitelist: /whitelist • Add a group: /whitelist add <chat_id> [group_name] • Remove a group: /whitelist remove <chat_id> Examples: • /whitelist - View all whitelisted groups • /whitelist add -1001234567890 Test group • /whitelist remove -1001234567890 Notes: • chat_id must be numeric • The group name is optional • After removal, the Bot automatically leaves the group Permission: Super administrator
admin.help.not_found.message: ❌ No help found for command /{command} Use /help to see all available commands
admin.help.overview.message: 🤖 Telegram Guard Bot I am a group management bot with the following features: ⚙️ Group configuration • /groupset - Group settings (unified entry) • /verifyconfig - View verification settings 👮 Group management • /kick - Kick member • /mute - Mute member • /ban - Ban member • /warn - Warn member • /cleanup - Clean up abnormal users 🚨 Report system • /spam or /report - Report/flag spam • /reports - View report list (admins) • /approve - Accept report (admins) • /reject - Reject report (admins) 🗑️ Message deletion • /delbefore - Delete messages before • /delafter - Delete messages after • /delrange - Delete message range 💡 Usage tips 1️⃣ Ask a super admin to whitelist the group 2️⃣ Add the Bot to the group and set it as admin 3️⃣ Use /help <command> for detailed usage Example: /help groupset
